from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class Paper(BaseModel):
    """Information extracted from a single provided paper regarding its citations."""
    title: str | None = Field(description="The title of this specific paper")
    references_to_provided_papers: list[str] = Field(description="Titles of other provided papers that are explicitly cited in this paper's bibliography")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    papers: list[Paper]
